Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Join a team building Fluxnova , the open-source successor of Camunda 7, for a leading global investment bank.
 We're looking for a Senior Java Engineer to help develop and scale a modern workflow platform used to run complex business processes at enterprise level. You'll collaborate with senior engineers across global teams and contribute to architecture, development, integration, and delivery of business-critical applications.
 What you'll do
Design and develop applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Angular
Build and integrate REST APIs and backend services
Contribute to application architecture and integration design
Participate in code reviews, testing, troubleshooting, and production support
Improve application quality, security, and performance
Support CI/CD processes and deployment activities
 What we're looking for
Strong Java and Spring Boot experience
Angular and TypeScript knowledge
Experience with Oracle databases and REST APIs
Understanding of application architecture and integration patterns
Experience with unit and integration testing
Familiarity with CI/CD practices and modern development workflows
 Nice to have
Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift
Kafka or RabbitMQ
Oracle performance tuning
Experience in financial services
 Technologies
 Java 17 • Spring Boot • Angular • TypeScript • Oracle • REST APIs • OAuth2 • JWT • JUnit • Maven • CI/CD • Docker • Kubernetes • Kafka
